purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claim) software — screen transition component for a confirmation screen (TID1) within the general summary / public expense claim subsystem
purpose.summary: This program is a screen-handling subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles the TID1 confirmation screen, processing LINK (initialization) and PUTG/CLICKED events to navigate between screens (back or register). It calls ORCDBMAIN to perform window transitions via the MCP framework.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-based parameter areas (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
17 COPY statements for screen and data layout includes
MCP event-driven screen framework (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WIDGET)
EVALUATE ALSO construct for multi-condition dispatch
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP middleware instead
High comment ratio (54%) with revision history in Japanese
verdict.notes: Japanese text in comments is garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. Fixed format with a few lines slightly over 72 characters (likely column 73-74 continuation or trailing spaces). No COMP-3 or SQL usage; relies entirely on the ORCA MCP framework for database and screen management.
